deployment_evidence.note: No production target capable of serving the vNext site application plus its PostgreSQL runtime is evidenced by the currently connected deployment surface. This is not a code-quality failure and does not invalidate shadow acceptance.

social_single_writer_preflight.cutover_rule: Do not enable vNext direct apply until a production runtime is live and independently healthy; then fence the legacy scheduled direct writer atomically before the first vNext apply. Preserve legacy state as read-only history and rollback evidence.

public_host_verification.note: Public-host browsing could not produce a fresh independent readback in this execution. Shadow WSGI projection is PASS, but that is not treated as proof that the new runtime is deployed at valceaclar.ro.

non_blocking_media_gap.policy: Missing user-owned assets does not block controlled-live because editorial-card/no-visual fallback is valid; user-owned photos remain migration/media debt and must retain ownership provenance when imported.

blocking_requirements_before_controlled_: Bind a production hosting target for the LOCAL NEWS OS vNext site application serving valceaclar.ro.
Provision and bind the PostgreSQL runtime secret LOCAL_NEWS_RUNTIME_DATABASE_URL to that production target.
Bind the private newsroom authentication secret required by the site runtime.
Deploy the already-validated vNext artifact without changing public DNS until health/readback passes on the target.
Run health and canonical-route parity against the deployed target.
Fence the legacy scheduled Facebook/Instagram direct writer atomically immediately before first vNext direct apply.
Perform one low-risk controlled-live story publication and independent public/social readback with rollback armed.
intervention_scope: Provide or authorize a production runtime target and PostgreSQL binding for valceaclar.ro; no editorial decision or code redesign is required.
